summary: Captains are combat-capable officers who provide leadership, tactical coordination, and access to Command Abilities.

units.name: Captain
units.description: Captains are experienced combatants and military leaders who provide tactical Commands to nearby troops. The standard Captain is an Elite Unit that occupies an E Recruitment Slot and does not count toward the Hero maximum. A Captain receives two eligible generic Captain Commands without additional cost; the Heroic Commission upgrade below makes it a Hero and lets it occupy an H Recruitment Slot.

options.name: Great Weapon
options.notes: Fewer but more damaging Attacks, with extra dice against Armored foes.

equipmentAndCombatTraining.note: A Captain may purchase up to two Combat Training upgrades. Weapon and equipment upgrades do not count toward this limit. A Captain may carry one ranged weapon in addition to their melee weapon.

options.name: Standard Equipment
options.effect: Retain the Captain's chosen melee weapon and standard defenses.

options.name: Shield
options.effect: Improve Armor from 5+ to 4+. May be used with Officer's Weapon or Spear.

options.name: Defensive
options.effect: Gain Brace 1, reducing incoming Charge Impact by 1.

options.name: Battle-Hardened
options.effect: Gain Tough 1, rerolling up to one natural 1 on Armor Saves.

options.name: Deadly Strikes
options.effect: One melee weapon gains Critical 1, converting up to one failed Hit die into a Critical Hit after rerolls; no Surge is required.

options.name: Monster Hunter
options.effect: One melee weapon gains Anti-Monster 1, increasing its Attacks by 1 against Monsters.

options.name: Mounted
options.effect: Increase Move to M6", gain +1 Wound and Charge 3. Loses Infantry tag and gains Cavalry.

options.name: Veteran
options.effect: The chosen weapon gains +1 Attack and improves Hit by one step.

options.name: Heroic Commission
options.effect: Gain Hero and H eligibility while retaining Elite; increase Wounds by 1; every weapon the Captain currently carries gains +1 Attack. The Captain now counts toward the three-Hero limit.

commands.note: Choose two Command Abilities at no additional cost. All listed Command Abilities cost 1 CP. In 2,000-point matched play, expend CP using the selected cards as described in the Matched-Play Command Points and Cards rules; campaign encounters may use abstract CP without any cards.

options.name: Press the Attack
options.effect: Choose one friendly Unit within Short. Its next melee Attack this Round gains Accurate 1.

options.name: Hold Formation
options.effect: When a friendly Unit within Short is successfully Charged, grant it Brace 1 against that Charge. Resolve before Impact.

options.name: Advance Orders
options.effect: Choose one unengaged friendly Unit within Short. Move it up to 2". It cannot finish Engaged.

options.name: Fire Discipline
options.effect: Choose one friendly Unit within Short. Its next ranged Attack this Round gains Accurate 1.

options.name: Standard Commands
options.effect: Know two eligible Captain Command Abilities.

options.name: Additional Command
options.effect: Learn one additional eligible Command Ability. Does not provide additional CP or Doctrine cards.

notes: Captains may substitute eligible faction-specific Command Abilities for generic ones, subject to the faction's rules.

units.battlefieldRole: Competent individual combatant, battlefield leadership, and tactical flexibility.
designNotes: v4 balance pass (post-playtesting): Damage-1 weapons gained +1 Attack; the Damage-2 Great Weapon kept its listed Attacks and gained Anti-Armored 2.

v4.1 refinement: the Captain is a single Model, so Veteran (+50) stays a flat cost rather than the higher per-unit pricing used on larger multi-Model formations like Line/Ranged Infantry. Master Hunter (+25, counts as a Combat Training pick) lets the Captain choose any Faction/Unit Type/Trait tag and gain Anti-[chosen tag] 2 on all of its weapons, complementing the narrower fixed Monster Hunter (+15, Anti-Monster 1).
The Captain is an Elite Unit (E) and not a Hero by default; Heroic Commission makes it a Hero and adds H eligibility while it keeps Elite.
